target.name: vellistry-dev
target.observation: Historical owner-confirmed metadata only; no current target inspection

decisions.required_contract: Reuse existing server-side SupabaseAuthService/guard. Verify exact bearer token with existing Auth; derive subject/session_id/expiry from cryptographically verified claims bound to the same token. Never trust decoded-only claims, headers, user_metadata, a caller-selected session or body author. Request-isolated immutable principal, pre/post async verification.
decisions.decision_required: Select existing-SDK verified-claims binding and failure mapping after local tests; no Auth replacement or dependency change.
decisions.acceptance: Wrong subject/session, expired/future/stale proof, mismatched token, malformed UUID, concurrent requests cannot cross-contaminate.

decisions.required_contract: A valid JWT/getUser alone does not establish an active writable session. Missing or unproven session must fail closed. Check matching session/user and expiry after lock acquisition, before book lock and operation commit.
decisions.decision_required: Owner/provider review is required before any real auth.sessions UPDATE(id) or locking grant. Evaluate managed-schema row-lock compatibility versus separately designed app-owned revocation registry; no option is approved here. Define inactivity/not_after semantics, clock policy, timeouts and revoke/commit linearization.
decisions.acceptance: Local/global/others logout, password/user revocation, expired sessions and cleanup lag, revoke-before-lock and revoke-after-lock, provider outage, refresh/key rotation, pool reuse. Hosted synthetic users/JWT probes need separate target authorization.

decisions.required_contract: Private server-only SQL capability executes named entry points; no broad author-table writes, browser SQL credentials, service-role author path or public Data API RPC. NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS function/lock owners remain experimental.
decisions.decision_required: Choose reviewed connection/pool/TLS/secret provisioning channel and exact role membership, scoped default ACL/ownership/search_path/RLS after metadata review. Never provision credentials now.
decisions.acceptance: Deny direct DML/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER, role escalation and helper calls; verify forced RLS and cross-author/book isolation through each entry point and reused connections.

decisions.required_contract: The four local SQL fixtures are not shipping migrations; preserve both operative migrations and separately retained third proposal.
decisions.decision_required: Shipping SQL paths UNALLOCATED. First review sanitized metadata via the existing15-query packet, then exact migration names/content and a separate reviewed-base owner SQL-path record before a new executable task. No third-migration deployment approval follows from this packet.
decisions.acceptance: Exclude synthetic auth.users/auth.sessions definitions, fixture users/passwords, fixture_probe/test_fault hooks and fixture-wide default ACL modifications; atomic function ownership/revoke setup and rollback/upgrade from both operative migrations.

decisions.required_contract: Retain owner+book+operation idempotency identity, request hash, receipts and minimum-version owned readback. Unknown outcomes cannot become definite failures or new-key retries. Process-local pending state does not survive browser/server restart.
decisions.decision_required: Choose a durable per-author/book operation outbox with data-minimal metadata and explicit retention/privacy/encryption decision for any note payload; preserve book-lifetime server journal and rejection receipts. No unreviewed in-progress committed row or TTL.
decisions.acceptance: Lost ACK after commit, unknown-not-found, same key/different hash, restart/restore, multi-instance concurrency, stale reads/receipts, account switch and cancellation do not duplicate or leak operations.

decisions.required_contract: Preserve current Next BFF verified-token forwarding and Nest verification, no-store responses and identity isolation; workspace service remains unregistered.
decisions.decision_required: Future production controller/routes require separately scoped owner authorization after principal/session/gateway/reconciliation decisions. Define bounded body parsing, validation/errors/unknown acknowledgements, request-scoped provider and adapter lifetime. Do not register a route in this task.
decisions.acceptance: Cross-book routes, forged ownership, pre/post identity switch, upstream partial body/timeouts, no-store caching, rate/body limits, keyboard/focus existing UI behavior and manuscript/revision invariance.
